Business Insight: Customer segments can be used to identify valuable customer groups and improve retention strategies.

Business Insight: Restaurant segments can help identify businesses that require operational improvement.

Business Insight: Negative sentiment and complaint categories can help identify areas affecting customer satisfaction.

Key Finding: Distance is the most important feature, with an importance score of approximately 0.797.
Business Insight: Delivery distance should be considered when planning delivery operations. The prediction model has limited explanatory power.

Key Finding: The historical peak hour is 02:00, while the quietest hour is 06:00.
Business Insight: Demand patterns can support hourly delivery-capacity planning. Forecast accuracy limitations should be considered.

Key Finding: Wallet payments have the highest average tip, approximately 102.51.
Business Insight: Payment method and delivery conditions show differences in average tip amounts, although observed correlations are weak.

Business Insight: Historical city-hour demand can help identify periods for closer capacity monitoring.
